author: Warhammer
description:
Dakka is louder, choppas hit harder, an' the boyz head into war on a massive scale – check out this first full gameplay look into the Orks in Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV! 

For Orks, war is loud, anarchic, and gloriously violent. It's all about taking on the biggest and baddest, krumping the enemy, and, most importantly, having a darn good scrap! In-game, the Orks make use of a number of tactical units and their unique Waaagh! ability to turn the tide on the battlefield.

Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV releases on Steam in 2026!

Wishlist NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272360
